raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #46806. `update_weights_from_disk` always reloads every model runner. Under speculative decoding with a separate draft checkpoint (DFLASH in the issue), the target's `model_path` is therefore also loaded into the draft. The DFLASH loader accepts the target's `model.layers.*` and `model.norm.weight` as its own, so the call reports success, but the acceptance length drops to ~1.0. The tensor and distributed requests already have a `selector` field to avoid this, but the disk request has none, so callers such as RL frameworks doing disk-based refits can't keep the draft out.

## Modifications

- `managers/io_struct.py`: add `selector: Optional[Literal["target", "draft", "all"]] = None` to `UpdateWeightFromDiskReqInput`, like the tensor and distributed requests. The HTTP endpoint picks the field up from the struct.
- `scheduler_components/weight_updater.py`: `update_weights_from_disk` uses the selector. Without one, the draft is reloaded only when it was loaded from the target's checkpoint (`speculative_draft_model_path` unset or equal to `model_path`, e.g. a bundled MTP layer), so that behavior is unchanged. A draft with its own checkpoint, such as DFLASH, keeps its weights. The cache is still flushed only when the target was reloaded.
- `entrypoints/engine.py`: `Engine.update_weights_from_disk` accepts `selector`.
- `docs/.../sglang_for_rl.mdx`: add `selector` to the request table and the Engine API signature.

This PR doesn't change the DFLASH loader silently skipping names it doesn't recognize. I asked in the issue whether a warning there is wanted.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: the target is reloaded as before; only a separate draft checkpoint is no longer overwritten.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Validation

- `test_scheduler_weight_version_tracking.py`: new tests for explicit `"target"` / `"draft"`, and for the default with a separate draft (skipped) and a bundled or absent draft path (reloaded). 92 passed together with `test_msgpack_ipc_roundtrip.py` and `test_io_struct.py`. With the old always-`"all"` default, the separate-draft test fails.
- `pre-commit run` passes on the changed files.

The issue shows that the target-only path (`selector="target"` on the tensor update) keeps the draft unchanged; for a DFLASH draft, the disk update now takes that path by default.

**Pending GPU validation** (I don't have a GPU; help welcome). With a separate DFLASH draft:
1. Record the draft's weight checksum and `model_path`, call `update_weights_from_disk` without a `selector`, and check that both are unchanged.
2. Compare the acceptance length on the same workload before and after the update.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 class UpdateWeightFromDiskReqOutput(BaseReq, kw_only=True):

 )
-from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_model, get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_model, get_parallel, get_spec
 from sglang.srt.utils.weight_checker import overall_checksum
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
@@ -140,7 +140,8 @@ def update_weights_from_disk(self, recv_req: UpdateWeightFromDiskReqInput):
         with self._observe_weight_load("disk"):
             success, message = True, "Succeeded to update model weights."
             target_updated = False
-            for role, runner in self._select_runners():
+            selector = recv_req.selector or self._default_disk_update_selector()
+            for role, runner in self._select_runners(selector):
                 success, message = runner.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk(
                     recv_req.model_path,

@@ -175,6 +176,13 @@ def destroy_weights_update_group(
         success, message = self.tp_worker.destroy_weights_update_group(recv_req)
         return DestroyWeightsUpdateGroupReqOutput(success=success, message=message)
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _default_disk_update_selector() -> str:
+        # A draft with its own checkpoint (e.g. DFLASH, EAGLE3) must not load the
+        # target's; a draft bundled in the target checkpoint is reloaded with it.
+        draft_path = get_spec().speculative_draft_model_path
+        return "all" if draft_path in (None, get_model().model_path) else "target"
+
     def _select_runners(self, selector: str = "all") -> List[Tuple[str, Any]]:
         roles = _parse_runner_selector(selector)
         runners: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []

@@ -251,6 +251,58 @@ def test_distributed_update_target_only_selector_skips_draft(self):
         target.weight_updater.load_weights_from_distributed.assert_called_once()
         draft.weight_updater.load_weights_from_distributed.assert_not_called()
 
+    def test_disk_update_target_only_selector_skips_draft(self):
+        """selector="target" must not load the target checkpoint into the draft."""
+        target, draft = _runner(), _runner()
+
+        output = self._manager(target, draft).update_weights_from_disk(
+            _request(selector="target")
+        )
+
+        self.assertTrue(output.success)
+        target.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk.assert_called_once()
+        draft.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_disk_update_draft_only_selector_skips_target(self):
+        """selector="draft" reloads only the draft and leaves the target alone."""
+        target, draft = _runner(), _runner()
+
+        output = self._manager(target, draft).update_weights_from_disk(
+            _request(selector="draft")
+        )
+
+        self.assertTrue(output.success)
+        target.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk.assert_not_called()
+        draft.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk.assert_called_once()
+
+    def _default_disk_update(self, draft_path):
+        target, draft = _runner(), _runner()
+        module = "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.weight_updater"
+        with (
+            patch(
+                f"{module}.get_spec",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(speculative_draft_model_path=draft_path),
+            ),
+            patch(
+                f"{module}.get_model", return_value=SimpleNamespace(model_path="target")
+            ),
+        ):
+            output = self._manager(target, draft).update_weights_from_disk(
+                _request(selector=None)
+            )
+        self.assertTrue(output.success)
+        target.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk.assert_called_once()
+        return draft.weight_updater.update_weights_from_disk
+
+    def test_disk_update_default_skips_draft_with_its_own_checkpoint(self):
+        """A separate draft (e.g. DFLASH) must not load the target's checkpoint."""
+        self._default_disk_update("draft").assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_disk_update_default_reloads_draft_bundled_in_target(self):
+        """A draft loaded from the target's checkpoint (e.g. MTP) is reloaded with it."""
+        self._default_disk_update("target").assert_called_once()
+        self._default_disk_update(None).assert_called_once()
+
     def test_end_runs_post_load_on_both_when_load_was_bypassed(self):
         """A P2P/RDMA session never calls load_weights, so end must run post_load_weights."""
         target, draft = _runner(), _runner()
